resources.string: The terminal runs in Termux, a separate app with git, ssh, python, node and more. Install it from F-Droid or GitHub (the Play Store version is outdated), then tap Terminal again.

One-time setup:

1. Allow "Run commands in Termux environment" for Kodex (App info → Permissions) if you denied it.
2. Paste this command in Termux and press Enter (the button copies it and opens Termux).
3. In Android settings, allow Termux "Display over other apps".

Then tap Terminal again.
